hits.about: BLVD Crescent is a stylish residential development by Emaar consisting of two towers of 21 and 39 floors. The project features stunning one, two and three-bedroom apartments featuring contemporary design, quality fittings and large floor-to-ceiling windows that let in plenty of light and frame breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain.Residents can enjoy advanced amenities for comfortable living in the heart of the city, including a state-of-the-art gym and spa with full facilities, outdoor swimming pool, a variety of restaurants, stores and a multifunctional lobby on the first floor, a rooftop with landscaped grounds, event halls, a playground for children, underground parking, security system with concierge and video surveillance.BLVD Crescent is located in the heart of Dubai near iconic landmarks such as Dubai Opera and Burj Khalifa. Nearby are the major shopping and entertainment centers Souk Al Bahar and Dubai Mall with its singing fountains. Thanks to the developed infrastructure of the Downtown area and the proximity of the complex to the metro station Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall, residents can easily move around the city. Palm Jumeirah Island, Burj Al Arab Hotel and The Walk JBR are all within a 15-25 minute radius, while the world's largest airport, Al Maktoum International Airport, is approximately 30 minutes away.BLVD Crescent is the ideal choice for those who value personal comfort and seek a modern lifestyle in the heart of a bustling metropolis.
